origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 射 (身 et 寸), tirer à l'arc, qui donnait le son mais se lit shè. Au départ, c'est prendre congé, décliner. Le sens a glissé vers les paroles qui remercient.
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 射 (身 and 寸), to shoot an arrow, which gave the sound but is read shè. At first it meant to take leave, to decline. The meaning slid towards words of thanks.

phrase.en: Thank you for coming to see me.
